How to read this atlas

Forward and reverse logos come from the original consensus table. Category comes from the instance summary. Seqlets and component motifs describe consensus construction; instances describe reconciled genomic occurrences.

Instances are summed across subtype records and are not a count of unique genomic loci across the atlas. “Subtypes” counts subtypes with a supplied count record. Reference scores retain their original meaning and are not relabeled as TOMTOM q-values.
